char_ratio_low.unit: ratio extracted_characters / pdf text_chars, text-mode pages only

char_ratio_high.unit: ratio extracted_characters / pdf text_chars, text-mode pages only

min_pdf_text_chars.unit: characters; pages with fewer PDF text characters are not ratio-checked

min_explained_fraction.unit: fraction of the PDF text characters of a page that table-of-contents items removed by the pipeline must cover before an empty K1 page is reported as an explained exclusion (INFO) instead of PAGE_EMPTY_EXTRACTION (WARN)
